name: SaitaChain
rootCause: SaitaChain’s XBridge bridge contracts were exploited on 2024-04-24 after the listToken() function allowed arbitrary callers to register themselves as token owners. The attacker used the forged ownership entry to call withdrawTokens() and drain bridge-held assets on Ethereum and BNB Chain. Public loss estimates ranged from roughly $1.0 million to $1.8 million, with DefiLlama and several incident reports converging on about $1.44 million. The XBridge4 contract exposed an access control flaw in listToken().
